title: Title & Registration Services Extension Tags: Allowance for a Late Handover
content:
On a Title & Registration Services order, the extension handover allowance is three days when the vehicle was handed over more than fourteen calendar days after the order's opening date, one day when it was handed over eight to fourteen days after that date, and nothing when it was handed over within seven days of the opening date. The allowance is a waiting allowance added, in whole days, on top of an extension tag's base validity.

The handover date is the one on the purchase order under Vehicle Purchase Agreements; the opening date is the title order's. The gap is counted in calendar days from the opening date to the handover date.

| Handover gap (calendar days after opening) | Handover allowance |
|---|---|
| more than 14 | 3 days |
| 8 to 14 | 1 day |
| 7 or fewer | nothing |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical, order opened 1 June)

| Handover date | Gap | Allowance |
|---|---|---|
| 8 June | 7 | nothing |
| 9 June | 8 | 1 day |
| 15 June | 14 | 1 day |
| 16 June | 15 | 3 days |
